isolation: One fresh empty local directory per approval. Stage just the five listed .dat inputs; rehash staged bytes and executable. No pre-existing restart or output; serial foreground process. Never launch from a source or archive directory.
failure_policy: Enforce the external deadline over startup and all I/O. Stop the launched process on timeout; retain original inputs, review, stdout, stderr, partial outputs, hashes, timestamps, runtime and exit code. Any failed check withholds acceptance. No retry or dynamic continuation.

acceptance.manifest_identity: Exact input and executable byte hashes before execution; version 4.0 banner. Exit 0, normal termination and zero executed events. Review all warnings; 4008 is expected for two directed probes.
acceptance.parser: All five Finished reading markers for simulation, lattice, energetics, mechanism and initial state.
acceptance.lattice_and_seeds: Exactly 7 sites, 4 acid, 3 oxygen, six typed undirected edges and two explicit seeds executed. Read the seven per-site rows and entity-to-site table in restart.inf. Require acid leg 1 / oxygen leg 2, vacancy species 0, two distinct bridge IDs, the same ID on both legs. Cross-check by physical positions, not internal ID ordering.
acceptance.catalogue: Use only initialization entries in process_debug.txt. Match the multiset of (step name, ordered nodes) one-to-one against numerical_reference.json; each of the four expected entries occurs once. Reject missing, duplicate, extra or reversed matches. Cumulative event counts cannot establish this.
acceptance.energy_and_rates: Check initial energy and per-placement propensity against the numerical reference. Rate comparison uses values printed by process_debug; validate each direction separately before summing.
